SyvPfLkkorvJJ1Ort3OOwg.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)今年截至第31週累計報告11萬4,004例疑病例(78%為5歲以下兒童),1,487例死亡,已超越去年全年疫情(83,486例,死亡1,187例),其中北基伍省和南基伍省(佔47.7%)為最嚴重地區。由於武裝衝突、人口流離及多種疾病(伊波拉、霍亂與瘧疾)同時傳播等影響,導致醫療體系嚴重負擔,無國界醫師(MSF)已在北基伍/南基伍省實施介入措施,避免疫情傳播。Beacon 8/18 瑞典疫情持續,今年截至8/24累計30例確定病例,均為參與今年音樂節(7/30-8/2)相關病例,多數為18歲以下未接種過疫苗之兒童,其中以斯德哥爾摩(9例)及西博滕省(6例)為多。由於該節日吸引約萬名遊客參加,該國與各地感染管制相關部門進行接觸者追蹤,並建議未接種疫苗或接種不完整者進行自主監測。 莫三比克自2025/7/29宣布爆發疫情後,截至今年8/18累計報告2,595例確定病例,4例死亡。主要以北部南普拉省(1,137例病例,4例死亡)較為嚴重,其次為索法拉省(585例)。相較今年3月資料(697例,1例死亡),短期間內增加1,898例。
SyvPfLkkorvJJ1Ort3OOwg.en: The DRC has reported 114,004 suspected cases this year as of week 31 (78% of them children under 5), with 1,487 deaths, already exceeding last year's total (83,486 cases and 1,187 deaths). The worst-affected areas are North Kivu and South Kivu provinces (47.7%). Armed conflict, population displacement and the simultaneous spread of multiple diseases (Ebola, cholera and malaria) are placing a severe burden on the health system. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) has implemented interventions in North Kivu and South Kivu to prevent transmission (Beacon, 18 August). Sweden's outbreak continues: as of 24 August this year, 30 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, all linked to this year's music festival (30 July–2 August). Most were unvaccinated children under 18, with cases concentrated in Stockholm (9) and Västerbotten (6). As the festival drew about 10,000 visitors, the country and regional infection-control authorities are conducting contact tracing and recommend self-monitoring for those who are unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Mozambique has reported 2,595 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 18 August this year, including 4 deaths, since declaring an outbreak on 29 July 2025. The worst-affected area is Nampula Province in the north (1,137 cases, 4 deaths), followed by Sofala Province (585 cases). Compared with 697 cases and 1 death in March this year, cases have increased by 1,898 in a short period.

BDmH8dd92cYbJ_CO-k6Qpw.zh: WHO 公布全球今年截至 3/29 累計報告 5 萬 8,740 例病例、732 例死亡,其中,3 月新增病例數較今年 2 月下降 17%,且較去年同期下降 56%,各國 CFR 介於 0-9.7%。病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞及美洲共 22 個國家/地區,近期新增病例以剛果民主共和國、阿富汗及莫三比克為多。WHO 評估約有 10 億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
BDmH8dd92cYbJ_CO-k6Qpw.en: WHO reports that globally, as of 29 March this year, 58,740 cases and 732 deaths have been reported cumulatively. New cases in March fell 17% from February this year and 56% from the same period last year. CFR across countries ranges from 0% to 9.7%. Cases are distributed across 22 countries and territories in the Eastern Mediterranean, Africa, South-East Asia and the Americas. Recent new cases are mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan and Mozambique. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people face infection risk, and the global risk of spread is very high.

epQxgzy6kwk5queoap9Urw.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至2/22累計報告3萬6,953例病例、451例死亡,其中,2月新增病例數較今年1月下降3%,且較去年同期下降50%,各國CFR介於0-10%。病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞及美洲共21個國家/地區,近期新增病例以剛果民主共和國、阿富汗及莫三比克為多。WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
epQxgzy6kwk5queoap9Urw.en: The WHO reports that globally, as of 22 February this year, 36,953 cases and 451 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Compared with January this year, new cases in February fell by 3%, and were 50% lower than the same period last year; case fatality rates in countries range from 0–10%. Cases have been reported in 21 countries and regions across the Eastern Mediterranean, African, South-East Asian and American regions. Recent new cases are concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan and Mozambique. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people are at risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.

5XEtA_ZwnbrgJaHgZpWDFQ.zh: WHO公布全球今年1月累計報告1萬6,912例病例,182例死亡,病例數較2025年12月下降6%,各國CFR介於0-16.7%;病例分布於東地中海、非洲及東南亞共19個國家/地區,近期新增病例以剛果民主共和國、阿富汗及莫三比克為多。WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
5XEtA_ZwnbrgJaHgZpWDFQ.en: WHO reports that globally, 16,912 cases and 182 deaths were reported cumulatively in January this year. Case numbers fell 6% compared with December 2025, and case fatality rates across countries range from 0–16.7%. Cases were distributed across 19 countries and regions in the Eastern Mediterranean, African and South-East Asian regions. Recent new cases are concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan and Mozambique. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people are at risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.

8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年迄今已累計25國通報逾95,345例病例(29,493例確診),其中582例死亡(CFR:0.61%),烏干達、幾內亞及迦納疫情上升,烏干達今年截至8/10已累計6,466例確診病例,其中41例死亡;莫三比克自今年7月爆發疫情,截至8/7累計170例疑病例,其中29例確診,迄無死亡案例,該國鄰近馬拉威、南非、尚比亞及辛巴威,跨境風險增加;獅子山疫情更新,該國今年截至8/11累計5,115例確診病例,疫情趨緩。
8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.en: Mpox outbreaks continue in Africa. So far this year, 25 countries have reported more than 95,345 cases (29,493 confirmed), of which 582 died (CFR: 0.61%). Outbreaks are rising in Uganda, Guinea and Ghana. Uganda had cumulatively reported 6,466 confirmed cases as of 10 August this year, of which 41 died. Mozambique's outbreak began in July this year; as of 7 August, 170 suspected cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 29 were confirmed, and no deaths have been reported so far. The country borders Malawi, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe, increasing cross-border risk. Sierra Leone's outbreak update: 5,115 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported this year as of 11 August, and the outbreak is easing.

pwgVuXwgQxYZH5w4V8jZZg.zh: 莫三比克7/11報告今年首起3例病例,其後截至20日累計發現報告13例病例、36例疑病例,集中於該國北部亞薩省,首3例病例皆由與該省鄰近之馬拉威移入,該區因鄰近坦尚亞及馬拉威等疫區,造成跨境風險增加,當局已採取相關邊境防疫措施。另該國前次報告疫情為2022年。 馬拉威自4月爆發疫情,截至7/19累計59例確診病例,逾200例疑病例,迄無死亡案例,多集中於該國首都里朗威,匡列逾600名接觸者,其中僅餘6例刻正隔離中,當局已針對疫情加強人員培訓、疫情監測及邊境檢疫等措施。
pwgVuXwgQxYZH5w4V8jZZg.en: Mozambique reported its first 3 cases on 11 July. As of 20 July, it had reported 13 cases cumulatively and 36 suspected cases, concentrated in Niassa Province in the north. The first 3 cases were all imported from neighboring Malawi. Because the area borders outbreak zones including Tanzania and Malawi, cross-border risk has increased, and authorities have implemented related border health measures. Mozambique's previous reported outbreak was in 2022. Malawi's outbreak began in April. As of 19 July, 59 confirmed cases and more than 200 suspected cases had been reported, with no deaths. Cases are concentrated in the capital, Lilongwe. More than 600 contacts have been identified, and only 6 of them remain in quarantine. Authorities have strengthened staff training, outbreak surveillance and border quarantine.

GpgpR5XCis2pppE1wg2n8Q.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至11/24累計33國報告733,000餘例病例及逾5,000例死亡;分別較去年同期增加37%及27%,病例數以東地中海區、非洲區及東南亞區為多,地區性戰爭衝突、自然災害等因素降低醫療服務資源可近性並加劇爆發疫情,WHO於11月通過審查新疫苗配方及生產流程,疫苗產量達2013年以來新高,以應付目前疫苗短缺之情況,評估全球疫情風險仍為非常高。 非洲地區今年截至12/21累計報告逾219,000例及3,500餘例死亡(CFR: 1.6%),南蘇丹於10月下旬宣布爆發疫情,迄今累計4,700餘例及47例死亡(CFR: 0.9%);蘇丹今年迄今累計49,000餘例及892例死亡(CFR: 1.8%),兩國近期受人道危機及天災影響,疫情持續擴大;迦納、莫三比克、坦尚亞及辛巴威持續報告病例。
GpgpR5XCis2pppE1wg2n8Q.en: WHO reported that globally as of 24 November this year, 33 countries had reported over 733,000 cases and over 5,000 deaths, increases of 37% and 27% respectively over the same period last year. Cases are concentrated in the Eastern Mediterranean, African and South-East Asian regions. Regional wars and conflicts, and natural disasters, have reduced access to health services and aggravated outbreaks. WHO approved a review of a new vaccine formulation and production process in November, and vaccine output reached its highest level since 2013 to address the current vaccine shortage. The global outbreak risk is still assessed as very high. In Africa, as of 21 December this year, over 219,000 cases and over 3,500 deaths (CFR 1.6%) had been reported cumulatively. South Sudan declared an outbreak in late October; to date, over 4,700 cases and 47 deaths (CFR 0.9%) have been recorded. Sudan has recorded over 49,000 cases and 892 deaths (CFR 1.8%) this year. Both countries are affected by humanitarian crises and natural disasters, and their outbreaks continue to expand. Ghana, Mozambique, Tanzania and Zimbabwe continue to report cases.
